arguments.message:
The SSO button only appears when your workspace’s domain is set up for SSO **and** the identity‑provider sync has already created your account. If the sync hasn’t run yet, or if your account doesn’t exist on the IdP side, you’ll only see the standard email/password fields.

You can ask an admin to verify that your account is listed in Settings → People – SSO‑provisioned accounts are marked with the identity provider name. If it’s missing, the sync may need to run again or your account may need to be created in the IdP first.
